name: k2
title: K2 (DFI, 1998): a Risc PC demo for the StrongARM
doc: A recipe: how to turn a user's own copy of the demo into a native executable. It holds no game data: the inputs are recognised by content (see $SS/tools/weave.py). The input is K2 as Acorn User's CD 6 (December 1998) has it - EVOLA/EVOLUTION/K2/ZIP, a Spark archive despite its name, copied off the CD - or the later zip with K2Patch (January 1999); only !k2 is used.

requires.superspider: ~/stuff/superspider, or $SUPERSPIDER (dune build): analyse, gen (--no-smc), tools/weave.py, tools/arm2.py
requires.libroger: ~/stuff/libroger, or make ROGER=... (OS_Module 11, module filing systems, roger_config.strongarm, ColourTrans_WritePalette)
